note: English credit-card catalogue special-offer tiles on ocbc.id (six tiles in plain HTML). The /en/promo All Promo grid is loaded by a same-origin POST to /api/sitecore/OPromoOCBC/GetPromo, but that call is made by JavaScript hosted on cdn1.ocbc.id, which is not in official_domains. Query-string filter URLs on /en/promo are disallowed by robots.txt (Disallow: /*?). This recipe therefore reads the special-offer tiles that are present in the English card catalogue HTML. Additional English promo pages from the official sitemap were read one by one.
